def korean_number(n):
    digits = ["", "일", "이", "삼", "사", "오", "육", "칠", "팔", "구"]
    units = ["", "십", "백", "천"]

    def convert_four(num):
        if num == 0:
            return ""
        result = ""
        str_num = str(num)
        length = len(str_num)
        for i, ch in enumerate(str_num):
            d = int(ch)
            if d == 0:
                continue
            pos = length - i - 1
            if d == 1 and pos > 0:
                result += units[pos]
            else:
                result += digits[d] + units[pos]
        return result

    if n == 0:
        return "영"

    upper = n // 10000
    lower = n % 10000
    result = convert_four(upper) + "만" + convert_four(lower) if upper else convert_four(lower)
    return result
